title: Spectrum of an exact Frobenius sequence
statement:
For a short exact sequence $0\to V'\to V\to V''\to0$ of finite
Frobenius modules whose maps commute with Frobenius, the spectrum of
$(V,F)$ (the multiset of the images under $\iota$ of the
eigenvalues, [def-weil-frobenius-module-weights]) is the multiset
union of the spectra of $V'$ and $V''$, counted with algebraic
multiplicity.

proof.text: Put S = ker π = range ι, using exactness. The relation π F = F'' π makes S invariant under F. Injectivity identifies V' linearly with range ι and hence with S; the relation ι F' = F ι intertwines F' with F restricted to S. Surjectivity gives the canonical first-isomorphism-theorem equivalence V/S ≃ V''. On each class [x], it sends the induced Frobenius to π(F x) = F''(π x), so it also intertwines Frobenius. LinearMap.charpoly_eq_of_comp_eq therefore identifies the two induced characteristic polynomials with those of V' and V''.

source.place: Proof, characteristic-polynomial factorization and root multiplicities

proof.text: Apply LinearMap.charpoly_eq_charpoly_restrict_mul_charpoly_mapQ from [p-linear-filtration] to F and S. Substituting the two characteristic-polynomial identifications gives χ_V = χ_V' χ_V''. This is the ordinary characteristic-polynomial form stated in the current blueprint_update of p-linear-filtration; no reversal or Laurent-polynomial conversion is required.

source.place: Proof, characteristic-polynomial factorization and root multiplicities

proof.text: Both outer characteristic polynomials are monic, hence nonzero; their product is nonzero over the field. Polynomial.roots_mul gives roots(χ_V) = roots(χ_V') + roots(χ_V'') with algebraic multiplicities. Applying Multiset.map iota and Multiset.map_add proves the asserted equality. This applies also in dimension zero, since the constant characteristic polynomial 1 is monic and has no roots.
